target.title: Make OpenAI base URL overridable for local/compatible servers
target.body:
## Summary

Adds `resolveOpenAIBaseUrl` so Birdclaw can target Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible server instead of hardcoding `https://api.openai.com/v1`.

- Reads `BIRDCLAW_OPENAI_BASE_URL`, falls back to `OPENAI_BASE_URL`, defaults to `https://api.openai.com/v1`.
- Trailing slashes are trimmed so callers can safely append `/responses`, `/chat/completions`.
- Inbox-scoring chat-completions call (`src/lib/openai.ts`) and the Responses-API hybrid-analysis runtime (`src/lib/openai-response-runtime.ts`) both build endpoints from the resolved base URL.
- Documented `BIRDCLAW_OPENAI_BASE_URL` and `BIRDCLAW_OPENAI_MODEL` in `docs/configuration.md`.

## Usage

```bash
export OPENAI_API_KEY=ollama
export BIRDCLAW_OPENAI_BASE_URL=http://localhost:11434/v1
export BIRDCLAW_OPENAI_MODEL=llama3.1
```

Note: inbox scoring uses `/chat/completions` (widely supported, e.g. Ollama); the analysis features use OpenAI's `/responses` API, which requires a server that speaks that shape.

## Test Plan

Ran tests (openai, openai-response-runtime, analysis-runtime) + `tsc --noEmit`. Added resolver coverage (default, override precedence, `OPENAI_BASE_URL` fallback, trailing-slash trim) and a test asserting the request hits the configured base URL.
